item.title: ChatCommands
item.description: ChatCommands is a Utility mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Adds chat commands for testing and QoL: give any item, summon entities, place/remove tiles, max or reset all skills, toggle invincibility. Requires CoreLib. What it does Give any item, summon any entity at your position Place/remove tiles relative to your position Max or reset all skills; toggle invincibility Requires CoreLib + CoreLib.Commands + CoreLib.RewiredExtension + CoreLib.Localization How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.

item.title: Core Keeper Waypoint & Collector Seeds — Fast-Travel Farm and Oracle Card
item.description: Once you’ve opened the Great Wall, the two things that slow you down are (a) walking between distant biomes and (b) hunting down the last collectibles. These two community-verified seeds attack both: one puts an Ancient Waypoint close enough to build a fast-travel loop early, the other points at a Sunken Sea sewer scene holding the rare Wisdom Oracle Card. Why we recommend these seeds Seed What you get Who it’s for 164131586535 Early Ancient Waypoint (reported “glitch” farm) Players who hate walking 582489510745 Sunken Sea sewer scene with the Wisdom Oracle Card Oracle Card completionists These are not “better loot” seeds — they’re convenience and completion seeds.

item.title: InstantPortalCharge
item.description: InstantPortalCharge is a Utility mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Removes the portal charge time — teleport instantly between connected portals. What it does Removes portal charge time entirely Instant travel between connected portals Useful in large co-op bases with many portals How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.io) and search for the mod, then Subscribe. Restart the game and enable the mod in the Mods menu.

item.title: More Equipment Sets
item.description: More Equipment Sets is a Utility mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Adds extra equipment set slots so you can swap builds without re-equipping everything. What it does Adds extra equipment set slots Swap between combat/farming/mining builds instantly Requires matching CoreLib version How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.io) and search for the mod, then Subscribe. Restart the game and enable the mod in the Mods menu.

item.title: MovableSpawners
item.description: MovableSpawners is a Utility mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Destroy boss summoning shrines and re-place them anywhere — convenient for building boss arenas at your base. What it does Destroy boss summoning shrines and rebuild them anywhere Build boss arenas at your base instead of traveling Great for co-op where everyone wants the kill credit How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.io) and search for the mod, then Subscribe.
